response_args.floor_justification: Storm alert and weather forecast of storm with active battery outage dictate raising reserve floor to 45% for reliability.
response_args.reasoning: Position is shortfall (-6.1 MW net position). Dispatch ladder step: renewables + battery discharge above floor. Golden rules binding: 1 (Reliability & Reserve Margin), 2 (Grid Stability headroom of 2.0 MW), and 4 (Battery protection/discharge limits). Objective cascade: cost_efficiency (cost then carbon then renewable utilisation). Discharging 6.1 MW from battery_1 fully covers the shortfall without needing grid purchase or DR, saving on high buy price and carbon. Reserve floor raised to 45.0% due to storm alert and multi-failure cascade.
